crossRefs.note: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by…
the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which…
He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
